pkgmetadata.longdescription: Zen Browser is a Firefox-based web browser aimed at calm, focused and productive browsing. This package compiles Zen from source (Firefox platform plus Zen's patches) with the system toolchain. The source tree is pre-baked outside the Portage sandbox by scripts/bake-engine.sh because Zen's patch application tool (surfer) needs pnpm and network access; compilation itself happens entirely inside the sandbox. Blocks www-client/zen-bin, which owns the same install paths.

use.flag: Force building with the LLVM/Clang toolchain and the lld linker
Build and install the geckodriver WebDriver implementation
Enable Mozilla's runtime hardening and full RELRO/BIND_NOW
Enable unified compilation of source files (faster build, more memory)
Add a second build pass to optimize with a profile generated under Xvfb (roughly doubles build time and disk use)
Pull in media-video/pipewire for screen sharing / WebRTC screen capture
Build the ffmpeg decode glue and pull in media-video/ffmpeg (dlopened at runtime); disabling removes h264/aac/etc. playback
Pull in media-libs/libva and default media.ffmpeg.vaapi.enabled to true for hardware video decoding
